PROFILE::list
       Returns all the names of the profiles of the class asked for that are attached to this virtual server.

SYNOPSIS
       PROFILE::list 'auth'

DESCRIPTION
       This command returns all the names of the profiles of the class asked for that are attached to this virtual server.

RETURN VALUE
       Returns all the names of the profiles of the class asked for that are attached to this virtual server

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
